description: This PHP file contains a unit test class LDAPConfigAPITest that tests the LDAPConfigAPI for LDAP configuration retrieval and update methods, as well as delete operation not implemented. It uses PHPUnit and related testing utilities to perform integration tests focusing on LDAP API interactions within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPConfigAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the LDAPConfigAPI's getOne, update, and delete functionalities, including data providers for different test cases.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single LDAP configuration via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetOne method.

methods.name: saveLDAPConfigPreHook
methods.description: A static method that sets up LDAP configuration data as a fixture before tests.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating LDAP configuration via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testUpdate method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that delete operation is not implemented and raises an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for delete operation is not implemented.
